question: How many customers are there? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: List the names of all genres. Return only the genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM genres

question: How many tracks are there in total? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks

question: List the first name and last name of customers from Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM customers WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: How many employees are there? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

question: What is the longest track length in milliseconds? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM tracks

question: Return the titles of the albums with ArtistId 1.
gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM albums WHERE ArtistId = 1

question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE Total > 10

question: List the names of all media types. Return only the name.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM media_types

question: List the distinct countries where customers live. Return only the country.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM customers

question: Which countries have more than 3 customers? Return the country and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

question: Return the titles of all albums by the artist named Iron Maiden. Return only the title.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM albums al JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: How many tracks are in the genre Jazz? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: For each media type, return the media type name and the number of tracks it has.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM media_types m JOIN tracks t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

question: Return the first name, last name and email of the customers supported by the employee Jane Peacock.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock'

question: What is the total amount of all invoices of customers from Germany, rounded to 2 decimals? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

question: List the names of the tracks on the album titled Let There Be Rock. Return only the track name.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: How many invoices did each customer from Brazil have? Return first name, last name and the invoice count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName

question: How many tracks are in the playlist named Grunge? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlists p JOIN playlist_track pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: For every employee who has a manager, return the employee's first name, last name, then the manager's first name and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId

question: Which country's customers spent the most in total? Return the country and the total spent, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which single customer spent the most in total? Return first name, last name and total spent, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in the year 2011? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011'

question: Which 3 artists have the most albums? Return the artist name and the number of albums.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Return the genre name and the number of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct tracks have been sold at least once? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) FROM invoice_items

question: Which customers have spent more than the average total spent per customer? Return first name and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: For each support employee, return their first name, last name and the total invoice amount of their customers, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

question: How many customers have spent more than 40 in total? Return a single number.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 40)

question: For each billing country with at least 5 invoices, return the billing country and the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM invoices GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
